title: Development of hematopoietic stem cell-targeted lipid nanoparticles through lipid composition optimization.
authors: Hiraki, Takamasa; Yamamoto, Keita; Chang, Yu-Hsuan; Nakayama, Chika; Wunderlich, Mark; Mizukawa, Benjamin; Nozaki, Emi; Kiribuchi, Daiki; Saito, Hidekazu; Ishihara-Sugano, Mitsuko; Kato, Motohiro; Goyama, Susumu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究造血干细胞靶向脂质纳米颗粒的优化与基因编辑递送，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hematopoietic stem cell (HSC)-targeted gene editing holds significant potential for treating hereditary hematopoietic disorders, yet the efficient and safe delivery of gene-editing tools into HSCs remains a critical challenge. Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have emerged as a promising platform for nucleic acid delivery; however, achieving high transfection efficiency in HSCs remains challenging. In this study, we developed HSC-targeted LNPs by integrating Bayesian optimization with our functional amino lipids. The optimized LNPs exhibited markedly improved transfection efficiency while preserving cell viability, surpassing earlier formulations. Using these LNPs, we achieved ex vivo TP53 gene editing in cord blood (CB) CD34(+) cells with up to 40% on-target editing efficiency. Additionally, one LNP demonstrated efficient RNA delivery into primary human monocytic leukemia cells. These results highlight the potential of machine learning-guided LNP design for advancing HSC-targeted therapies and underscore the promise of LNP-based gene-editing platforms to treat hereditary and malignant hematopoietic disorders.
abstract_zh: 造血干细胞（HSC）靶向基因编辑在治疗遗传性造血系统疾病方面具有巨大潜力，然而将基因编辑工具高效且安全地递送至HSCs仍是一项关键挑战。脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）已成为核酸递送的有前景平台；然而，在HSCs中实现高转染效率仍具难度。在本研究中，我们通过将贝叶斯优化与我们的功能性氨基脂质相结合，开发了HSC靶向LNPs。优化后的LNPs在保持细胞活力的同时，显著提高了转染效率，超越了早期配方。利用这些LNPs，我们在脐带血（CB）CD34(+)细胞中实现了离体TP53基因编辑，靶向编辑效率高达40%。此外，一种LNP展示了向原代人单核细胞白血病细胞高效递送RNA的能力。这些结果凸显了机器学习引导的LNP设计在推进HSC靶向治疗方面的潜力，并强调了基于LNP的基因编辑平台在治疗遗传性和恶性造血系统疾病中的前景。
